---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a feature or improvement for ApplySharp
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem statement

What problem are you trying to solve? What is the user story?

Example: "When applying on Workday I have to retype the same answers across 5 pages because ApplySharp only fills page 1."

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen. Be specific.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why this one is better.

## Impact

Who benefits from this and how often. Helps us prioritize.

- [ ] Affects a specific ATS or job platform: \_\_\_
- [ ] Improves a specific user workflow: \_\_\_
- [ ] Fixes a recurring frustration

## Roadmap context

Have you checked [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) to see if this is already planned?

## Additional context

Mockups, links to similar features in other tools, or anything else helpful.
